reviews.comment: This class is so cool omg I love Dr. Dulin and n.development. Lecture topics are so so cool and Dulin is an expert & great teacher of this content. Exams are easy if you pay attention to lecture and quizzes are very few questions for such a large piece of grade. Take this class if you're a nerd you will love it. #1 class i took as neuro HANDS DOWN

Dr. Dulin is an amazing professor and is incredibly passionate about her class and ensuring that her students succeed. I wish I could take her for other classes, and I would recommend the concepts learned to any major, not only neuroscience. Just be sure to study in advance and read the scientific paper each week!

As a professor, she's ok and pretty chill. The exams (midterm and final) are hard as some questions are detail oriented, all FRQ. It's tough to get an A as there's so much information to study for (as each lecture have over 60 slides), so do not procrastinate. The topic reviews are helpful as the exams is mainly based on those.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Dulin is incredibly knowledgeable and is very accessible for questions. She is great at clearly explaining concepts in class. However, your grade is heavily weighted by just 2 exams and a small homework percentage. The exams are mostly open answer so if you do not study, you will not pass. The class is definitely doable but you have to work.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Dulin is awesome, but treat this like a difficult stem class. The class has changed since these other reviews were written. Tests are not online or open notes. There's a midterm and a cumulative final, with sm information on both. I.E. the midterm was on 8 power points, each with 75ish slides densely packed with info. Lots of studying required.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr Dulin is actually pretty cool and her class is not too difficult. Her tests are online and open note which helps balance out the fact that the material can be pretty specific. Take this class as a NRSC elective if you need to

Dr. Dulin is one of the BEST professors at TAMU. Take her if you can!! Her lectures are so interesting and keep you engaged despite the material/topics being complex. She makes me wish I had been a neuroscience major instead. I cannot recommend her enough!!! 
4 hw, 2 exams, participation, EC if you dress up as Sonic.
